what: execution study for the daily-flat book: every held position is opened at the 18:00 ET reopen and closed before 16:10 ET. Market orders cost 1 tick + commission per side in the backtest. Limit alternative on ES / NQ 1-minute trades 2018-26: entry: limit 1 tick better than the 18:00 reference (open of the first minute), filled only if the price trades 1 tick THROUGH it within 15 minutes, else market (1 tick) at the 15th minute; exit: same from 15:50 ET (reference = 15:50 open), market at 16:05 ET. Cost in ticks vs the reference, buys and sells, adverse selection included
use: the measured average cost per side replaces the 1-tick assumption in a re-run of the daily-flat equity book (scripts/v99/df3_cost.py with the implied multiplier)
